author: Wahiz
body:
IGN: SaTiSfAcTiOn__ a.k.a Sheep_Ship


I know I have evaded my punishments many of countless times and I have had staff members say stop because it outs pressure on them and I never wanted that to happen
so I have stopped during my break and I will never do it ever again and I know you are all like "oh he is full of shit" and well see you tomorrow or something like that
but you wont see me for awhile now im going back to school cause vacation is over and ill be gone for 1 month on Christmas break and then gone for another 6 so you wont
see me by the time you discuss this appeal and answer me back.

With my free time I have been thinking about my ban evading and why I did it, I guess the truth is that I kept missing avicus and I couldn't fight the urge of not
ban evading, and when I was doing it I was well aware it was wrong but the urge fought even harder.

I also have taken a look at all my infractions I have ever received from the staff team and I agree with every single one of those because there all true..

But all you guys know me as the jerk who used to Ban evade and was really mean but that was months ago and I have matured and changed a lot, like most people from the
server who hated me are now some of my close friends. So why not give it a shot and see what the new me is all about and if you don't like it then fine you can ban me
ill accept it but give it a shot please.....

So idk what to do anymore and this will probably the last time I try to appeal my infraction except maybe when i amfinished school for the year...

So now ill leave it to you guys to decide what to do with me, I will accept all of your choices but there is one question that still sticks around my brain is that
the player by the name DaGoldBrick who had ban evaded more then me and hacked every time he ban evaded has been un banned yet what he did was worst then me... I don't mean
to sound like an ass or anything but im just wondering and if you could answer my question it would be much appreciated.

Welp Thanks For Reading :P

-Dawson <3
